note: Desktop D3D11 observations; no physical PICO FPS claim. Stage-1 comparisons share the old preview settings; final preview has corrected existing PICO LOD budget.

runs.label: v061-baseline-desktop-repeat
runs.description: Two continuous daytime first approaches sail from the original harbor spawn to home and then wind island using the production route, Engine and Rigidbody; planning and first approach frames are included, without teleports or warmup. Sixteen separate steady cases retain twelve near-shore sailing and four home empty-hand/AK cases; only their setup teleports and three-second warmups have segment_id=0. This does not certify physical keyboard input, all-world navigation, cold OS caches or headset performance.
